name: ecom Tab-Ex 05 DZ1
summary: The ecom Tab-Ex 05 DZ1 is a flameproof (Ex d) 8-inch Android tablet from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 16.

otherSchemes: Common Criteria portal listing for the Tab-Ex family

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db ia IIC T6 Gb / II 2D Ex tb ia IIIC T80°C Db
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 1 (2025-08-05), checked 2026-10-25. ATEX certificate read from ecom PDF (EU-type examination, BV notified body 2004).

iecex.marking: Ex db ia IIC T6 Gb / Ex tb ia IIIC T80°C Db

certification.northAmerica: SGS certificate SGSNA/25/CA/00003X (ecom file CERT-7841): Class I Division 1, Group A, B, C, D, T6; Class II Division 1, Group E, F, G T80C; Class III T80C; Ex db ia IIC T6 Gb; Class I, Zone 1, AEx db ia IIC T6 Gb; Zone 21, Group IIIC T80C; Ta −20 °C to +55 °C
certification.protection: Flameproof enclosure (Ex db) with an intrinsically safe circuit (Ex ia)

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: flameproof joints shall not be repaired; protect against high-energy impacts; do not use near processes producing high electrostatic charges; charging and SIM/SD-card replacement only in ordinary (non-hazardous) locations; charge only at −5 °C to +55 °C; charging and wired data via USB-C limited to Um 30 V (and the certificate's current limit) and from a SELV/PELV/ES1 supply; user may replace only the USB-C cover; repairs by the manufacturer or an authorised service centre.
safety.peripherals: SIM and microSD are reachable only in non-hazardous areas (flameproof cover). The USB-C port is intrinsically safe and may be used for wired data connections in the hazardous area within its entity parameters (Uo 5.6 V, Io 500 mA, Po 600 mW, Co 1 µF, Lo 1 µH); charging via USB-C only in non-hazardous areas. The S Pen is intrinsically safe and may be used in the hazardous area. Wireless peripherals (Bluetooth, DeX) are not restricted by the certificate text.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the certificate: S Pen ST T05 X2, leather case LC T05 X1, chest harness CH T05 X1, belt clip BC T01, carrying strap CS T05, stylus tether ST 01. The Ident-Ex 02 wireless 1D/2D scanner carries its own Ex approval (Zone 1/21, Div 1). Chargers, docks and holders on the ecom page are for use outside the hazardous area only.

os.name: Android
os.edition: Android (Samsung One UI); Android Enterprise Recommended, Samsung Knox 3.10

specs.display: 8-inch TFT, capacitive multitouch, 60 Hz / adaptive up to 120 Hz; Corning Gorilla Glass 3 (DZ1/DZ2), Gorilla Glass 5 (D2)
specs.outdoor: Maker claims optimum readability in direct sunlight (600 nits max)
specs.chip: Samsung Exynos 1380 (S5E8835) octa-core, 4 x 2.4 GHz + 4 x 2.0 GHz, 5 nm
specs.camera: 13 MP autofocus, 8x digital zoom (camera-free version available)
specs.ports: USB 2.0 Type-C; 3.5 mm audio jack and POGO pins on DZ2; microSD; nano-SIM / eSIM
specs.docking: DZ2: Lite Cradle, DC T01 X2 desktop charger, passive holder with tilt/swivel (ordinary areas)
specs.network: 5G Sub-6 and 4G LTE; Wi-Fi-only version also available
specs.keys: Function key (programmable: PTT, emergency call, alarm) and Active button
specs.biometrics: Face recognition; fingerprint only on the D2 model
specs.touch: Yes: glove touch and wet-hands operation (maker)
specs.pen: Samsung S Pen included (pressure sensitive), with Tab-Ex S Pen holder
specs.keyboard: No keyboard; wireless DeX with Bluetooth keyboard/mouse; POGO keyboard-dock port on DZ2 (ordinary areas only)

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via app (programmable function key assignable to PTT, per ecom)

capabilities.label: Emergency / SOS
capabilities.value: Built in (freely programmable function key, e.g. emergency call or alarm)

capabilities.label: Lone worker
capabilities.value: Via app (key assigned to alarm/emergency; third-party or ecom lone-worker solution)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via accessory (ecom Ident-Ex 02 wireless 1D/2D scanner; Ex-rated? yes) or camera-based via app

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (front and rear cameras, Google ARCore ready; ecom promotes remote-support use)

capabilities.label: Windows desktop software
capabilities.value: Not possible (Android; Samsung DeX gives a desktop-style Android UI)
